explication: Prism is a syntax-highlighting library for browsers and Node.js. Its principal workflow accepts source text or a DOM code element, resolves a language grammar, tokenizes the input, and renders highlighted output; browser helpers also process code elements. Language definitions and plugins extend the core, while optional plugins add conveniences such as autoloading, line numbers, previews, and command-line highlighting. The graph reflects documented capabilities and relationships visible in the supplied excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementations are represented at their supported directory paths, without asserting unverified calls.
